meta.description: IQ2GQ Hub - matched syndicate NRL picks against real-world match results and bookmaker odds
meta.source_odds_data: aussportsbetting.com Historical NRL Results and Odds Data (personal use only, not for redistribution - derived/matched data only, no raw odds-file rows reproduced verbatim beyond what's needed for this join)
meta.matching_method: Team name canonicalisation + nearest-date match within +/-8 days of the recorded pick date (NRL rounds run Thu-Mon; syndicate historically locked picks by Friday 7:30pm)
meta.generated_note: 8 rows carry data_quality_flag = RESULT_DISCREPANCY_UNRESOLVED: the nearest-matched real game's outcome contradicts the syndicate's recorded Result for that pick. Investigated at length and left unresolved by syndicate decision (2026) - Sheet Results were NOT altered to match, and games were NOT re-matched to force agreement. Treat these 8 rows with caution in any analysis.
meta.excluded_rows_note: 5 additional syndicate NRL picks (Feb 2022-2024) were excluded entirely: they are NRL pre-season trial picks, which fall outside the regular-season/finals coverage of the odds data source.
